recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It is a narrow current-build consistency fix that completes the applied FHIR-12057 model change without reopening label cardinality or adding redundant prose.
issue_request: FHIR-12057 was a Published FHIR-core StructureDefinition change request for DSTU2 asking to change ElementDefinition.example from 0..1 to 0..* so multiple examples can be supplied. The final Persuasive with Modification resolution was to use a repeating example component with label and value[x].
initial_application: The issue was applied in commit 16760763e2fe435ccdb9dc8ae77e0a7442c2d9fd, which changed source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml from ElementDefinition.example[x] 0..1 to ElementDefinition.example 0..*, adding ElementDefinition.example.label and ElementDefinition.example.value[x]. The authoritative datatype spreadsheet still has those correct rows.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists ElementDefinition as a datatype and maps elementdefinition to the elementdefinition page, so source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml and source/elementdefinition.html both feed the current build. Jira and Confluence searches found no later final decision reversing FHIR-12057. A 2022 Zulip discussion questioned mandatory ElementDefinition.example.label, and Grahame Grieve supported keeping label mandatory, so the current label/value[x] structure was preserved.
reconciliation: Changed source/elementdefinition.html so the interpretation table names the current ElementDefinition.example field instead of the removed example[x] choice element. No change was needed to source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml because it already carries the 0..* cardinality and label/value[x] structure.
source_changes: source/elementdefinition.html: changed the ElementDefinition interpretation table row from example[x] to example.
